_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to user_configs/app_config.json and fill in. This file is tracked so the
shape of the override layer is visible to a fresh clone; the real file next to it is not.
Every key here is OPTIONAL and deep-merges leaf by leaf onto configs/app_config.json:
what you omit keeps the tracked default, and every applied override is reported at boot
The tokens below carry "active": false, so this template cannot authenticate anything even
if it is loaded by accident. Set it to true once you have replaced the values — and note
that a copy with every token inactive refuses to boot, which is the intended, actionable
failure rather than an engine serving with no credentials.
The journal_names keys below are deliberately NOT twelve lowercase hex characters, so they
can never match a real journal fingerprint: a mapping copied without editing then resolves
nothing and reports 'unknown' rather than labelling some database 'production'.

ide.note: who holds this token — answered here, not remembered at rotation time

diagnostics.token: <a second token, revocable on its own>
diagnostics.note: example of a narrow grant: two reports, no signals, no spend
